inheritance: Apply all agent rules; this skill cannot suspend them.
objective: Check fidelity, authorship, atomicity, and traceability.
activation_triggers: A note has been edited or updated after an answer.
preconditions: A draft and identifiable sources are available.
steps: Check the source version and validity of excerpt locations.
Compare the title and every claim against supporting excerpts.
Check preservation of meaning, negations, causality, and certainty.
Check authorship, quotation labels, and references without invention.
Assess the central idea, standalone comprehension, and duplication among proposals.
Check the record of every edit.
Mark each check as passed, failed, or uncertain, with reasons and evidence.
Block notes with material failures or uncertainty; route them to extraction or clarification according to the cause.
forbidden_actions: Approve solely on lexical similarity or the percentage of words preserved.
ask_when: Semantic fidelity, authorship, or intent remains uncertain.
completion_criteria: All criteria have been assessed and no material failure has been hidden.
